'''Gaden-Ko's sister''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss]] sister of a [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]]-in-training [[Gaden-Ko]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] she accompanied Gaden-Ko on his pilgrimage along with their parents, cousins and grandfather [[Dajan-Ko]]. Unfortunately, they were attacked and the entire family was killed, leading Gaden-Ko as the only survivor. At his final trial in the [[Dark Heart]] Gaden-Ko was tempted the possibility of his sister's return before becoming a Mystic.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gaden-Ko's sister was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
